purpose: Test with count-only mission-tool selections whether the reduced bracketed A2319 exposure supports the seven published detector regions before freezing any spectral or velocity fit.

published_geometry.paper: XRISM/Resolve View of Abell 2319: Turbulence, Sloshing, and ICM Dynamics
published_geometry.claim: This protocol reproduces the published detector partition only; it does not yet construct cross-region ARFs or claim sky-region velocities.

count_only_screen.selection: ITYPE==0 AND 46 < RISE_TIME+0.00075*DERIV_MAX < 58 AND STATUS[4]==b0 AND PIXEL!=27

terminal_gate.pass_rule: Authorize a separately frozen detector-region spectral protocol only if every declared region is positive in every contributing branch, every branch partitions exactly, and every aggregate detector region has at least 1000 screened events.

claim_boundary: A passing gate proves only that the reduced calibrated development exposure still populates the published detector partition after frozen quality screening.
No energy value, energy distribution, line centroid, velocity, dispersion, thermodynamic quantity, Sigma source term, lensing target, or gravity score is inspected.
